name: ivory-coast-social-contributions
description: Use this skill for Côte d'Ivoire (Ivory Coast) social contributions in 2026 under the CNPS general scheme: pension, family benefits, maternity, work injury and CMU, with the contribution floor and ceilings, the contribution base, monthly or quarterly payment and the e-CNPS steps. It is for employers, payroll staff and accountants handling salaried workers in the private sector. Trigger on "CNPS", "cotisations sociales", "retraite Côte d'Ivoire", "AT/MP", "CMU", "plafond CNPS", "e-CNPS" or questions on what an employer owes on a salary in Ivory Coast. It does not cover the self-employed RSTI scheme or public sector pensions, and it reads with the payroll skill.
